title: Trello Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs, and Hidden Fees
summary: Trello pricing tiers determine which collaboration features and automation limits your team can access. Use these details to select the right plan.
body_markdown:
## Managing Trello automation costs with Activepieces


Activepieces connects to Trello alongside 735+ other integrations to process complex logic outside of the Atlassian ecosystem, bypassing internal automation quotas.


By shifting the heavy lifting of multi-step workflows to an independent open-source platform, you'll avoid the hard caps on Butler command runs that typically trigger tier upgrades.


### Moving complex automation to external tools


Offloading Trello’s internal automation to Activepieces transforms the board from a processing hub into a simple data source.


Instead of using Butler to evaluate complex "if-then" conditions across multiple lists, a single Trello webhook sends the raw event to Activepieces, where the actual branching logic occurs.


This architecture ensures that a workflow involving five different apps only counts as one interaction within Trello's ecosystem. The following visual demonstrates a standard offloading configuration where Trello acts only as the initiator.


\[SCREENSHOT: A three-step workflow on the builder canvas with the third step selected. Step 1 is "Catch Webhook" (Webhook trigger), step 2 is "Read Connection" (Connections action), and step 3 is "Send Message To A User" (Slack action with blue selection border). The right panel shows the Slack step configuration with fields for Connection (showing "2. Read Connection"), User, Message, and Username, plus a "Generate Sample Data" section with a Test Step button.\]


By selecting the Slack action as the final step, you'll complete the bridge between Trello and external communication channels without using a single "Command Run" for the notification itself. This setup is a scalable blueprint for any cross-platform operation.


### Reducing per-seat costs through external triggers


Activepieces reduces the necessity for high-tier Trello seats by offering advanced automation features to users on lower-cost plans.


Because Trello caps command runs on its Free and Standard tiers, with unlimited runs on Premium and Enterprise, you'll often pay for expensive seats just to access those tools.


Moving these triggers to Activepieces allows a Standard-tier team to execute Enterprise-level workflows. This effectively decouples functional power from the per-user monthly fee.


### Avoiding Trello automation overage failures


Using an external orchestrator prevents the sudden workflow failures that occur when a Trello workspace hits its monthly automation ceiling.


When Butler reaches its limit, all subsequent rules simply stop firing. This creates silent data gaps in your project management history.


Activepieces provides the same SSO, SCIM, and custom RBAC in its air-gapped edition as it does in the cloud, allowing high-volume boards to run thousands of tasks without impacting the automation availability of other boards in the same workspace.
